description: Zener Diode Independent 20V 350mW Surface Mount SOD-123

provenance.pins: two-terminal Zener, DO-214AC/SOD outline: pin 1 = cathode-band end, pin 2 = opposite. Polarity from the package drawing, not inferred from function

designVerdict: SELECTED - clamps the BSS138 follower gate
notes: Hynetek's reference specifies 28 V. 20 V is chosen deliberately for margin: it puts the VBUS pin at roughly 18.5 V, comfortably inside its 3.15-29.4 V window, where a 28-30 V Zener would place it at ~28.5 V against a 29.4 V recommended maximum. The chip functions we rely on - VBUS presence detection and supply backup - work anywhere in that range, and OVP/UVP are lost to the clamp topology regardless.
DEVIATION FROM THE VENDOR REFERENCE. Worth validating that nothing else depends on the pin tracking VBUS more closely.
